args.goal: On the buyer's awarding screen, click Create Proposal, fill every required proposal field except Procurement Type, leave Procurement Type empty, click Submit Proposal, and stop when the proposal remains unsubmitted and Procurement Type is highlighted with a required-field message containing "is a required field".
